title: My Birthday Yesterday
gist_ar: حكاية عن عيد ميلاد إمبارح بصيغة was/were.
text: Yesterday was Friday. It was my birthday. I was very happy. My family were with me at home. There was a party. My friends were there too. The food was delicious. My mother was in the kitchen all day. Last week I was sick, but yesterday I was fine. It was a wonderful day. Why was it wonderful? Because my family were together.

questions.q: Where was his mother all day?
How was the writer last week?
questions.q_ar: الكاتب كان عامل إيه الأسبوع اللي فات؟
